reason_code_checkpoints_by_domain.name: reason_code_checkpoints_by_domain
reason_code_checkpoints_by_domain.value: ("reason_code"."domain" = 'RECIPIENT_CONTACT' AND "reason_code"."valid_checkpoints" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("reason_code"."valid_checkpoints") >= 1 AND "reason_code"."valid_checkpoints" <@ ARRAY['PRE_DISPATCH', 'NEXT_STOP', 'DOORSTEP']::text[]) OR ("reason_code"."domain" <> 'RECIPIENT_CONTACT' AND "reason_code"."valid_checkpoints" IS NULL)

reason_code_operations_by_domain.name: reason_code_operations_by_domain
reason_code_operations_by_domain.value: ("reason_code"."domain" IN ('SESSION_REVOCATION', 'STAFF_PROFILE_REJECTION', 'STAFF_MFA_RESET', 'CREDENTIAL_ADMINISTRATION', 'RIDER_DEVICE_REPLACEMENT', 'RIDER_DEVICE_REVOCATION') AND "reason_code"."permitted_operations" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("reason_code"."permitted_operations") >= 1 AND "reason_code"."permitted_operations"::text ~ '^\{[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(#[A-Z][A-Z_]*)?(,[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*(#[A-Z][A-Z_]*)?)*\}$') OR ("reason_code"."domain" NOT IN ('SESSION_REVOCATION', 'STAFF_PROFILE_REJECTION', 'STAFF_MFA_RESET', 'CREDENTIAL_ADMINISTRATION', 'RIDER_DEVICE_REPLACEMENT', 'RIDER_DEVICE_REVOCATION') AND "reason_code"."permitted_operations" IS NULL)

audit_event_structured_are_objects.name: audit_event_structured_are_objects
audit_event_structured_are_objects.value:
("audit_event"."device_context" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("audit_event"."device_context") = 'object')
        AND ("audit_event"."before_after" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("audit_event"."before_after") = 'object')
        AND ("audit_event"."related_ids" IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof("audit_event"."related_ids") = 'object')
        AND jsonb_typeof("audit_event"."detail") = 'object'

idempotency_record_answer_when_completed.name: idempotency_record_answer_when_completed
idempotency_record_answer_when_completed.value:
("idempotency_record"."state" = 'COMPLETED' AND "idempotency_record"."response_status" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_record"."response_body" IS NOT NULL AND "idempotency_record"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("idempotency_record"."state" = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND "idempotency_record"."response_status" IS NULL AND "idempotency_record"."response_body" IS NULL AND "idempotency_record"."completed_at" IS NULL)

idempotency_record_sealed_is_whole.name: idempotency_record_sealed_is_whole
idempotency_record_sealed_is_whole.value:
("idempotency_record"."sealed_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("idempotency_record"."sealed_nonce" IS NULL)
        AND ("idempotency_record"."sealed_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("idempotency_record"."sealed_key_version" IS NULL)
        AND ("idempotency_record"."sealed_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("idempotency_record"."sealed_envelope_version" IS NULL)
        AND ("idempotency_record"."sealed_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("idempotency_record"."sealed_expires_at" IS NULL)

credential_delivery_job_queued_is_untouc.name: credential_delivery_job_queued_is_untouched
credential_delivery_job_queued_is_untouc.value: "credential_delivery_job"."state" <> 'QUEUED' OR ("credential_delivery_job"."attempt_count" = 0 AND "credential_delivery_job"."deferred_claims" = 0 AND "credential_delivery_job"."lease_version" = 0 AND "credential_delivery_job"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" IS NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."accepted_at" IS NULL)

credential_delivery_job_lease_when_lease.name: credential_delivery_job_lease_when_leased
credential_delivery_job_lease_when_lease.value: "credential_delivery_job"."state" <> 'LEASED' OR ("credential_delivery_job"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."lease_version" >= 1 AND "credential_delivery_job"."attempt_count" >= 1)

credential_delivery_job_accepted_when_ac.name: credential_delivery_job_accepted_when_accepted
credential_delivery_job_accepted_when_ac.value: ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'ACCEPTED') = ("credential_delivery_job"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("credential_delivery_job"."provider_message_ref" IS NULL OR "credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'ACCEPTED')

credential_delivery_job_provider_fields_.name: credential_delivery_job_provider_fields_bounded
credential_delivery_job_provider_fields_.value: length("credential_delivery_job"."provider_dedupe_id") BETWEEN 16 AND 128 AND ("credential_delivery_job"."provider_message_ref" IS NULL OR length("credential_delivery_job"."provider_message_ref") BETWEEN 1 AND 256)

credential_delivery_job_payload_is_whole.name: credential_delivery_job_payload_is_whole
credential_delivery_job_payload_is_whole.value: ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_nonce" IS NULL) AND ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_key_version" IS NULL) AND ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_ciphertext" IS NULL) = ("credential_delivery_job"."payload_envelope_version" IS NULL)

credential_delivery_job_payload_follows_.name: credential_delivery_job_payload_follows_state
credential_delivery_job_payload_follows_.value: ("credential_delivery_job"."state" IN ('QUEUED', 'LEASED', 'RETRYABLE') AND "credential_delivery_job"."payload_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."payload_erased_at" IS NULL) OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" IN ('ACCEPTED', 'FAILED', 'EXPIRED', 'CANCELLED') AND "credential_delivery_job"."payload_ciphertext" IS NULL AND "credential_delivery_job"."payload_erased_at" IS NOT NULL)

credential_delivery_job_outcome_follows_.name: credential_delivery_job_outcome_follows_state
credential_delivery_job_outcome_follows_.value:
("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'QUEUED' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" IS NULL)
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'LEASED')
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'RETRYABLE' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" IN ('UNKNOWN', 'RELINQUISHED', 'REDEMPTION_UNCONFIRMED', 'PAYLOAD_DEFERRED'))
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'ACCEPTED' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" = 'ACCEPTED')
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'FAILED' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" IN ('REJECTED', 'DESTINATION_NOT_ALLOWED', 'SCHEDULE_EXHAUSTED', 'PAYLOAD_UNREADABLE'))
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'EXPIRED' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" = 'EXPIRED')
        OR ("credential_delivery_job"."state" = 'CANCELLED' AND "credential_delivery_job"."outcome_class" = 'CANCELLED')

session_policy_revision_by_principal.name: session_policy_revision_by_principal
session_policy_revision_by_principal.value:
("session"."principal_type" = 'STAFF' AND "session"."policy_revision" IS NULL)
        OR ("session"."principal_type" IN ('VENDOR', 'RIDER') AND "session"."policy_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "session"."policy_revision" >= 1)

setup_grant_purpose_by_principal.name: setup_grant_purpose_by_principal
setup_grant_purpose_by_principal.value:
("setup_grant"."principal_type" = 'STAFF' AND "setup_grant"."purpose" IN ('STAFF_CREDENTIAL_SETUP', 'MFA_ENROLMENT', 'MFA_REENROLMENT', 'BOOTSTRAP_SETUP'))
        OR ("setup_grant"."principal_type" = 'RIDER' AND "setup_grant"."purpose" IN ('RIDER_DEVICE_ENROLMENT', 'RIDER_DEVICE_REREGISTRATION'))
        OR ("setup_grant"."principal_type" = 'VENDOR' AND "setup_grant"."purpose" IN ('VENDOR_CREDENTIAL_SETUP', 'VENDOR_DEVICE_ENROLMENT'))

setup_grant_expiry_by_purpose.name: setup_grant_expiry_by_purpose
setup_grant_expiry_by_purpose.value:
("setup_grant"."expires_at" IS NULL) = ("setup_grant"."purpose" = 'BOOTSTRAP_SETUP')
        AND ("setup_grant"."expires_at" IS NULL OR "setup_grant"."expires_at" > "setup_grant"."issued_at")

setup_grant_consumed_whole.name: setup_grant_consumed_whole
setup_grant_consumed_whole.value:
("setup_grant"."state" = 'CONSUMED') = ("setup_grant"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("setup_grant"."consumed_at" IS NULL OR "setup_grant"."consumed_at" >= "setup_grant"."issued_at")

setup_grant_attestation_by_purpose.name: setup_grant_attestation_by_purpose
setup_grant_attestation_by_purpose.value:
("setup_grant"."purpose" IN ('RIDER_DEVICE_ENROLMENT', 'RIDER_DEVICE_REREGISTRATION')) = ("setup_grant"."attestation_challenge_hash" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("setup_grant"."attestation_challenge_hash" IS NULL OR octet_length("setup_grant"."attestation_challenge_hash") = 32)

setup_grant_one_lineage.name: setup_grant_one_lineage
setup_grant_one_lineage.value: NOT ("setup_grant"."supersedes_grant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "setup_grant"."continued_from_grant_id" IS NOT NULL)

setup_grant_no_self_lineage.name: setup_grant_no_self_lineage
setup_grant_no_self_lineage.value: "setup_grant"."supersedes_grant_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "setup_grant"."id" AND "setup_grant"."continued_from_grant_id" IS DISTINCT FROM "setup_grant"."id"

recovery_request_consumed_whole.name: recovery_request_consumed_whole
recovery_request_consumed_whole.value:
("recovery_request"."state" = 'CONSUMED') = ("recovery_request"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("recovery_request"."consumed_at" IS NULL OR "recovery_request"."consumed_at" >= "recovery_request"."issued_at")

notification_lease_when_leased.name: notification_lease_when_leased
notification_lease_when_leased.value: "notification"."state" <> 'LEASED' OR ("notification"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "notification"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "notification"."lease_version" >= 1 AND "notification"."attempt_count" >= 1)

notification_lease_owner_bounded.name: notification_lease_owner_bounded
notification_lease_owner_bounded.value: "notification"."lease_owner" IS NULL OR length("notification"."lease_owner") BETWEEN 1 AND 128

notification_sent_follows_state.name: notification_sent_follows_state
notification_sent_follows_state.value: CASE WHEN "notification"."channel" = 'SMS' THEN ("notification"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("notification"."state" IN ('SENT', 'DELIVERED') OR ("notification"."state" = 'FAILED' AND "notification"."outcome_class" = 'DELIVERY_FAILED')) ELSE "notification"."sent_at" IS NULL END

notification_provider_fields_bounded.name: notification_provider_fields_bounded
notification_provider_fields_bounded.value: ("notification"."provider_message_ref" IS NULL OR length("notification"."provider_message_ref") BETWEEN 1 AND 256) AND ("notification"."provider_outcome_class" IS NULL OR "notification"."provider_outcome_class" ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,47}$') AND ("notification"."destination_hint" IS NULL OR length("notification"."destination_hint") <= 24) AND ("notification"."destination_digest" IS NULL OR "notification"."destination_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

notification_delivered_when_delivered.name: notification_delivered_when_delivered
notification_delivered_when_delivered.value: CASE WHEN "notification"."channel" = 'SMS' THEN ("notification"."state" = 'DELIVERED') = ("notification"."delivered_at" IS NOT NULL) ELSE "notification"."delivered_at" IS NULL END

notification_reserved_has_its_digest.name: notification_reserved_has_its_digest
notification_reserved_has_its_digest.value: "notification"."reserved_at" IS NULL OR "notification"."destination_digest" IS NOT NULL

outbox_operation_and_correlation_bounded.name: outbox_operation_and_correlation_bounded
outbox_operation_and_correlation_bounded.value: length("outbox"."operation_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 96 AND length("outbox"."correlation_id") BETWEEN 1 AND 128

outbox_pending_holds_no_lease.name: outbox_pending_holds_no_lease
outbox_pending_holds_no_lease.value: "outbox"."relay_state" <> 'PENDING' OR ("outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "outbox"."relayed_at" IS NULL)

outbox_lease_when_leased.name: outbox_lease_when_leased
outbox_lease_when_leased.value: "outbox"."relay_state" <> 'LEASED' OR ("outbox"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "outbox"."lease_version" >= 1 AND "outbox"."attempt_count" >= 1)

outbox_lease_owner_bounded.name: outbox_lease_owner_bounded
outbox_lease_owner_bounded.value: "outbox"."lease_owner" IS NULL OR length("outbox"."lease_owner") BETWEEN 1 AND 128

staff_identity_email_shape.name: staff_identity_email_shape
staff_identity_email_shape.value:
length("staff_identity"."work_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320
        AND length("staff_identity"."work_email_canonical") BETWEEN 3 AND 320
        AND "staff_identity"."work_email_canonical" = btrim("staff_identity"."work_email_canonical")

staff_identity_credential_whole.name: staff_identity_credential_whole
staff_identity_credential_whole.value:
("staff_identity"."credential_hash" IS NULL) = ("staff_identity"."credential_established_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("staff_identity"."credential_hash" IS NULL) = ("staff_identity"."credential_generation" = 0)

mfa_factor_enrolment_follows_status.name: mfa_factor_enrolment_follows_status
mfa_factor_enrolment_follows_status.value:
("mfa_factor"."status" <> 'PENDING' OR "mfa_factor"."enrolled_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("mfa_factor"."status" <> 'ACTIVE' OR "mfa_factor"."enrolled_at" IS NOT NULL)

mfa_factor_administrative_revocation_who.name: mfa_factor_administrative_revocation_whole
mfa_factor_administrative_revocation_who.value:
("mfa_factor"."revoked_by" IS NULL) = ("mfa_factor"."revocation_reason_code" IS NULL)
        AND ("mfa_factor"."revoked_by" IS NULL) = ("mfa_factor"."revocation_episode_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("mfa_factor"."revocation_reason_code" IS NULL OR length(btrim("mfa_factor"."revocation_reason_code")) > 0)
        AND ("mfa_factor"."revoked_by" IS NULL OR "mfa_factor"."status" = 'REVOKED')

trusted_browser_revocation_is_whole.name: trusted_browser_revocation_is_whole
trusted_browser_revocation_is_whole.value: ("trusted_browser"."revoked_at" IS NULL) = ("trusted_browser"."revocation_cause" IS NULL) AND ("trusted_browser"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL OR "trusted_browser"."revoked_by" IS NULL) AND ("trusted_browser"."revoked_at" IS NULL OR "trusted_browser"."revoked_at" >= "trusted_browser"."created_at")

trusted_browser_revoker_follows_cause.name: trusted_browser_revoker_follows_cause
trusted_browser_revoker_follows_cause.value: ("trusted_browser"."revocation_cause" IN ('SELF', 'ADMINISTRATOR') AND "trusted_browser"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL) OR ("trusted_browser"."revocation_cause" = 'REPLACED' AND "trusted_browser"."revoked_by" IS NULL) OR "trusted_browser"."revocation_cause" IN ('FACTOR_RESET', 'FACTOR_REPLACED', 'CREDENTIAL_CHANGED') OR "trusted_browser"."revocation_cause" IS NULL

rider_identity_pin_whole.name: rider_identity_pin_whole
rider_identity_pin_whole.value:
("rider_identity"."pin_hash" IS NULL) = ("rider_identity"."pin_established_at" IS NULL)
        AND ("rider_identity"."pin_hash" IS NULL) = ("rider_identity"."credential_generation" = 0)

rider_identity_pin_bounded.name: rider_identity_pin_bounded
rider_identity_pin_bounded.value: "rider_identity"."pin_hash" IS NULL OR length("rider_identity"."pin_hash") BETWEEN 1 AND 1024

rider_sign_in_challenge_context_needs_ri.name: rider_sign_in_challenge_context_needs_rider
rider_sign_in_challenge_context_needs_ri.value: "rider_sign_in_challenge"."device_context_hash" IS NULL OR "rider_sign_in_challenge"."rider_identity_id" IS NOT NULL

vendor_organization_contact_present.name: vendor_organization_contact_present
vendor_organization_contact_present.value: "vendor_organization"."contact_phone" IS NOT NULL OR "vendor_organization"."contact_email" IS NOT NULL

vendor_organization_decision_by_status.name: vendor_organization_decision_by_status
vendor_organization_decision_by_status.value:
("vendor_organization"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL) = ("vendor_organization"."operational_status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'REJECTED', 'SUSPENDED', 'TERMINATED'))
         AND ("vendor_organization"."decided_by" IS NULL) = ("vendor_organization"."decided_at" IS NULL)

vendor_credential_whole.name: vendor_credential_whole
vendor_credential_whole.value: ("vendor_credential"."secret_hash" IS NULL) = ("vendor_credential"."credential_established_at" IS NULL) AND ("vendor_credential"."secret_hash" IS NULL) = ("vendor_credential"."credential_generation" = 0)

vendor_credential_secret_bounded.name: vendor_credential_secret_bounded
vendor_credential_secret_bounded.value: "vendor_credential"."secret_hash" IS NULL OR length("vendor_credential"."secret_hash") BETWEEN 1 AND 1024

vendor_credential_channel_present.name: vendor_credential_channel_present
vendor_credential_channel_present.value: "vendor_credential"."recovery_phone" IS NOT NULL OR "vendor_credential"."recovery_email" IS NOT NULL

vendor_credential_email_shape.name: vendor_credential_email_shape
vendor_credential_email_shape.value: "vendor_credential"."recovery_email" IS NULL OR (length("vendor_credential"."recovery_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320 AND "vendor_credential"."recovery_email" !~ '[[:space:][:cntrl:]]' AND position('@' in "vendor_credential"."recovery_email") > 1)

vendor_credential_delivery_channel_held.name: vendor_credential_delivery_channel_held
vendor_credential_delivery_channel_held.value: ("vendor_credential"."delivery_channel" IS DISTINCT FROM 'PHONE' OR "vendor_credential"."recovery_phone" IS NOT NULL) AND ("vendor_credential"."delivery_channel" IS DISTINCT FROM 'EMAIL' OR "vendor_credential"."recovery_email" IS NOT NULL)

registered_device_vendor_shape.name: registered_device_vendor_shape
registered_device_vendor_shape.value:
"registered_device"."principal_type" <> 'VENDOR' OR ("registered_device"."vendor_account_id" = "registered_device"."principal_id"
          AND "registered_device"."rider_identity_id" IS NULL
          AND "registered_device"."public_key" IS NULL
          AND "registered_device"."device_kind" = 'VENDOR_BROWSER_CREDENTIAL'
          AND "registered_device"."device_credential_hash" IS NOT NULL
          AND octet_length("registered_device"."device_credential_hash") = 32)

registered_device_rider_shape.name: registered_device_rider_shape
registered_device_rider_shape.value:
"registered_device"."principal_type" <> 'RIDER' OR ("registered_device"."rider_identity_id" = "registered_device"."principal_id"
          AND "registered_device"."vendor_account_id" IS NULL
          AND "registered_device"."device_credential_hash" IS NULL
          AND "registered_device"."device_kind" = 'RIDER_ANDROID_KEYPAIR'
          AND "registered_device"."public_key" IS NOT NULL
          AND "registered_device"."public_key" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{121}[AQgw]==$')

registered_device_end_follows_status.name: registered_device_end_follows_status
registered_device_end_follows_status.value: ("registered_device"."status" = 'ACTIVE') = ("registered_device"."ended_at" IS NULL) AND ("registered_device"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "registered_device"."ended_at" >= "registered_device"."registered_at")

pickup_request_one_sender.name: pickup_request_one_sender
pickup_request_one_sender.value: ("pickup_request"."pickup_intent" = 'ADHOC_SENDER' AND "pickup_request"."ad_hoc_sender_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pickup_request"."vendor_organization_id" IS NULL) OR ("pickup_request"."pickup_intent" <> 'ADHOC_SENDER' AND "pickup_request"."vendor_organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pickup_request"."ad_hoc_sender_id" IS NULL)

pickup_request_minimum_packages.name: pickup_request_minimum_packages
pickup_request_minimum_packages.value: "pickup_request"."declared_package_count" >= 2 OR "pickup_request"."one_package_exception_id" IS NOT NULL OR "pickup_request"."state" IN ('PENDING', 'CANCELLED', 'DECLINED')

pickup_request_collection_shape.name: pickup_request_collection_shape
pickup_request_collection_shape.value: ("pickup_request"."pickup_intent" = 'COLLECT_FOR_VENDOR') = ("pickup_request"."collection_point" IS NOT NULL) AND ("pickup_request"."pickup_intent" = 'COLLECT_FOR_VENDOR') = ("pickup_request"."destination_location_id" IS NOT NULL)

pickup_request_split_consistent.name: pickup_request_split_consistent
pickup_request_split_consistent.value: ("pickup_request"."default_payer_intent" = 'SPLIT') = ("pickup_request"."split_basis" IS NOT NULL) AND ("pickup_request"."split_basis" = 'FIXED_AMOUNT') = ("pickup_request"."split_sender_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL) AND ("pickup_request"."split_basis" = 'PERCENTAGE') = ("pickup_request"."split_sender_percentage" IS NOT NULL)

pickup_request_confirmation_facts.name: pickup_request_confirmation_facts
pickup_request_confirmation_facts.value: ("pickup_request"."confirmed_at" IS NULL) = ("pickup_request"."confirmed_by" IS NULL) AND ("pickup_request"."state" <> 'CONFIRMED' OR "pickup_request"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)

pickup_request_cancellation_facts.name: pickup_request_cancellation_facts
pickup_request_cancellation_facts.value: ("pickup_request"."state" = 'CANCELLED') = ("pickup_request"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("pickup_request"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) = ("pickup_request"."cancelled_by" IS NULL) AND ("pickup_request"."state" = 'CANCELLED' OR ("pickup_request"."cancellation_reason_code" IS NULL AND "pickup_request"."cancelled_by_actor_type" IS NULL AND "pickup_request"."cancellation_charge_outcome" IS NULL))

pickup_request_waiver_facts.name: pickup_request_waiver_facts
pickup_request_waiver_facts.value: coalesce("pickup_request"."cancellation_charge_outcome" = 'WAIVED', false) = ("pickup_request"."cancellation_charge_waived_by" IS NOT NULL) AND ("pickup_request"."cancellation_charge_snapshot" IS NOT NULL) = coalesce("pickup_request"."cancellation_charge_outcome" IN ('APPLIED', 'WAIVED'), false)

pickup_request_escalation_facts.name: pickup_request_escalation_facts
pickup_request_escalation_facts.value: "pickup_request"."escalated_at" IS NULL OR "pickup_request"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL

pickup_manifest_dispatch_facts.name: pickup_manifest_dispatch_facts
pickup_manifest_dispatch_facts.value: ("pickup_manifest"."state" = 'DRAFT' AND "pickup_manifest"."dispatched_at" IS NULL) OR "pickup_manifest"."state" = 'CANCELLED' OR ("pickup_manifest"."state" IN ('DISPATCHED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED') AND "pickup_manifest"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pickup_manifest"."assigned_rider_id" IS NOT NULL)

pickup_stop_failure_facts.name: pickup_stop_failure_facts
pickup_stop_failure_facts.value: ("pickup_stop"."state" = 'FAILED') = ("pickup_stop"."failure_category" IS NOT NULL) AND ("pickup_stop"."failure_reason_snapshot" IS NULL OR "pickup_stop"."state" = 'FAILED')

pickup_stop_carryover_facts.name: pickup_stop_carryover_facts
pickup_stop_carryover_facts.value: "pickup_stop"."carryover_snapshot" IS NULL OR ("pickup_stop"."carryover_snapshot" ->> 'reason_code') IS NOT NULL

pickup_stop_moment_facts.name: pickup_stop_moment_facts
pickup_stop_moment_facts.value: ("pickup_stop"."state" <> 'PENDING' OR "pickup_stop"."arrived_at" IS NULL) AND ("pickup_stop"."state" NOT IN ('PENDING', 'ARRIVED') OR "pickup_stop"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
